acne.description: Acne-prone skin often has breakouts, inflammation, and excess oil.

remedies.name: Tea Tree Oil
remedies.benefit: Natural antiseptic to kill acne-causing bacteria.

normal.description: Normal skin is balanced, neither too oily nor too dry.

oily.description: Oily skin has enlarged pores and a shiny appearance due to excess sebum.

remedies.name: Multani Mitti (Fuller's Earth)
remedies.benefit: Absorbs excess oil and tightens pores.

eczema.description: Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis) causes dry, itchy, and inflamed skin patches.

remedies.name: Coconut Oil & Vitamin E
remedies.benefit: Deeply hydrates and restores skin barrier.

remedies.name: Oatmeal Bath
remedies.benefit: Soothes intense itching and reduces redness.

psoriasis.description: Psoriasis causes skin cells to build up quickly, forming scales and itchy dry patches.

remedies.name: Apple Cider Vinegar Rinse
remedies.benefit: Helps balance scalp pH and reduce scaling.

tips: Keep skin moist at all times.

fungal_infection.description: Fungal infections can cause red, itchy, scaly rashes in circular patterns.

remedies.name: Garlic & Honey Paste
remedies.benefit: Inhibits fungal growth and speeds up healing.

dark_spots.description: Hyperpigmentation or dark spots caused by sun damage or post-acne scars.

remedies.name: Potato Juice & Lemon
remedies.benefit: Natural bleaching agents to lighten spots.

remedies.name: Papaya Pulp Mask
remedies.benefit: Contains enzymes that exfoliate dark skin cells.

remedies.name: Sandalwood & Milk
remedies.benefit: Evens out skin tone and cools inflammation.

tips: Incorporate Vitamin C into your routine.
